workout_entries.notes: Lat pulldown machine: 160 lb × 8 reps × 2 sets. Bodyweight dips: 12 reps × 2 sets. Seated machine row: 175 lb × 10 reps, then 190 lb × 10 reps. Machine rope triceps extensions: 130 lb × 10 reps × 2 sets. One-arm dumbbell bench row: 65 lb × 8 reps each arm × 2 sets. Single-arm overhead dumbbell triceps extension: 25 lb × 10 reps each arm × 2 sets.
